ruling.recommended_action: Refund $4.65 (surge differential) to the rider's original payment method; remind the driver-app team that the surge notice must state the new multiplier, revised fare AND the free-cancel option; no route action needed.
ruling.reasoning:
No safety content in the chats, complaint or driver statement; no route deviation (F1: actual 2.6 km is 0.1 km under the 2.7 km recommended route, within RD-1 tolerance; F3 confirms distance billed does not exceed optimal).

Surge: the quote was $10.41 at 1× (F6) and the trip ran at 1.6× from trip start (F7), giving $15.06 — $4.65 above the quote (F8). The rider was given notice before pickup (F9, 21:31:30 vs 21:34:00 start), and the notice does state the new multiplier (1.6×) and the revised estimated fare ($15.91). It does NOT state that the rider may cancel without penalty, so under SURGE-1 the notice is incomplete ("missing any item → not notified") and SURGE-2 row 2 applies: full refund of the surge differential. Differential: (1.6 − 1) × $8.63 = $5.18, but capped at the actual overcharge of $4.65 (F8) — refund $4.65. No other cause contributes: distance/time are at or below estimate (F1–F3), so no RD or other clause adds or subtracts.

The rider's fraud flag (F14) raises the confidence threshold to 95% (TH-3); the evidence here is complete (timestamped chats F12, full GPS/fare records F1–F9) and exactly one rule row applies, so the threshold is met. Amount $4.65 is under $10, so the system ruling is final (TH-1 / TH-2).

element_findings.element: Surge notice stated the new multiplier
element_findings.reason: Notice text names '1.6× the usual rate'.

element_findings.element: Surge notice stated the revised estimated fare
element_findings.reason: Notice text: 'Your new estimated fare is $15.91.'

element_findings.element: Surge notice stated the rider may cancel without penalty
element_findings.reason: Notice mentions only demand and the new multiplier/fare; no cancellation-without-penalty wording — SURGE-1 requires all three items, so rider was 'not notified'.

element_findings.element: Reason the fare exceeded the quote
element_findings.reason: Entire $4.65 difference is the 1×→1.6× surge rise on the surgeable subtotal; no deviation or time/distance excess (F1–F3).

rejected_claims.reason: Driver statement that he drove the app's route is consistent with GPS (F1: no deviation), but the price was set by the app's surge, which is a platform issue, and his statement cannot cure the incomplete surge notice.
